name: sporthub-ui-e2e
description: Pure-UI Playwright E2E test suite for SportHub Prototype against SRS

scripts.test:srs-audit: node -e "process.env.SRS_FULL='1'; import('node:child_process').then(m => { const r = m.spawnSync('npx', ['playwright', 'test', ...process.argv.slice(2)], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1); })"
